rv.q: What 'Maybe Happy Ending' asks, even in its ambivalent title, is whether that's a good thing, for them and for us, their mirror images.
With stellar comedic performances, a sensitively designed set, and unexpected emotional weight, Happy Ending guarantees to give you what the title suggests.

Whilst some, dimly-lit sexual activity is implied during the course of proceedings, the play is at great pains to suggest that two needy souls may in fact have the basis for a more interesting and substantial connection
